manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
